card.name: Numbers inside body-weight formulas
card.fires_on: Operators and numbers just before a numeric value in a calculation formula, mostly ideal or lean body weight (e.g. 50 + 0.91 x height) and dose-per-kg or size formulas.

modes.label: Weight formulas
modes.description: The plus sign or first digits in ideal or lean body weight equations.

modes.label: Other measurement formulas
modes.description: Words or symbols before a figure in a size, gel-length or per-kg calculation.
modes.example: ulcer length x ulcer width<< x>> 0.6

modes.label: Approximate measure
modes.description: The word 'about' before a number of degrees.
modes.example: the lower and upper part of your fist measures<< about>> 10 degrees.

card.plain: It fires on the plus, times or number slots in weight and size formulas, right before the next number.
